en.title: Chrome Hazard: Neon Requiem — Pulse of Oblivion and Memory of Steel
en.premise: Having lost his memories, Kaito spends his days alongside Mia and a calico cat as a crew member aboard the Ark, a ghost ship traveling the skies of freedom. But peace never lasts long. A "lost letter" pointing toward fragments of his forgotten past arrives in Kaito's hands as a heavily encrypted physical media. It was a warning sent by his former self to his future self. Deep within the metropolis, a flawed program—like a broken sword—begins to stir once again.

zh.title: 赛博危机：霓虹安魂曲 —— 遗忘的脉动与钢铁的记忆
zh.premise: 失去记忆的凯特（Kaito），与米娅（Mia）以及一只三毛猫一同作为穿梭于自由天空的幽灵船“方舟”的船员，度过着每一天。然而，平静并未持续多久。一封指引着失落记忆碎片的“失信”化作高度加密的物理载体送到了凯特手中。那是过去的自己写给未来的自己的警告。在都市的深渊中，犹如“断剑”般的缺陷程序再次开始运转。
